name: Atheism
overview: Scripture reveals the undeniable evidence of God's handiwork in creation, as seen in the natural world where animals, the earth, and the sea testify to the Lord's sovereign power and care. Job reminds us that every living soul and the breath of mankind are held in God's hand, underscoring His intimate involvement with all life. This understanding challenges atheistic views by affirming that wisdom and understanding come from recognizing God's creative authority evident in all things.
